name: Graphify Labs
long_description: Graphify builds queryable knowledge graphs from local codebases and documents, 96K GitHub stars, 3.8M downloads, used in production by engineers at Rootly, Geotab, and Tweddle Group.The enterprise layer on top, a self-learning brain that continuously syncs an organisation's knowledge, evolves its own graph over time without forgetting, and enables formal verification of code and architecture decisions. Runs fully on-premise. No data leaves the building.
one_liner: On-device knowledge graph engine for enterprises
